title: End-to-end timing reconciliation
motivation: Two F-AHL06 timing harnesses produced opposite small effects: about 6% slower without runtime checks versus about 4.4% faster with -fcheck=all. Both used batches of only about 4 ms, insufficient for a robust performance decision.
question: Does the optimized exact-theta plus lookup-C/K provider reduce total Reference Richards solve CPU under a longer paired timing protocol?

timing_policy.order: alternate analytical->split and split->analytical by repetition
timing_policy.primary_statistic: median of paired split/analytical CPU ratios

fidelity: Must retain the frozen F-AHL06/F-AHL04A fidelity gates before timing is interpreted.
